risk_summary: The excerpt is heavily quantified and provides clear year-over-year performance, capital, revenue, credit-loss, and expense metrics, supporting relatively strong disclosure quality. Risk language is extensive and includes litigation, regulatory, market, tax, Brexit, LIBOR, and credit-loss uncertainties, but much of it is standard forward-looking and safe-harbor boilerplate. Overall tone is cautiously positive, driven by materially improved 2018 earnings and capital ratios, with residual uncertainty around legal liabilities and financial-market conditions.
